token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the attacker deployed the (token, quote) pair before graduation

pair_token_a_reserve_wei.meaning: internal reserve of tokenA in the pair after the attacker's direct deposit and sync
pair_token_a_reserve_wei.checkpoint: after attacker deposit and sync, before graduation

attacker_quote_supplied_wei.meaning: amount of quote the attacker supplies to a newly created token to trigger the mass attack

graduation_succeeds.meaning: graduation completes without reverting, depositing 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the UniSwapV2 pool

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged caller able to deploy the pair and deposit 1 wei before graduation.
The 1 wei quote supply is the per-token attack amount stated by the impact; the report does not give a numeric definition of 'massive attack' beyond this per-token 1 wei.
The 20% token and all quoteReserve deposit amounts are intended graduation logic, not observed values.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is permissionless/any caller; the attack precondition is treated as an unprivileged attacker assumption.
'Massive attack' has no numeric definition beyond supplying 1 wei of quote per newly created token; the per-token magnitude is bound but the aggregate scale is not.

limitations: Formalizes only the target impact i_mass_attack_1wei_per_token; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
The graduation success relation is a Boolean outcome because the report gives no numeric post-state for the pool deposit.
Permanence of the DoS is asserted but not independently established; the plan encodes the reported attack setup and graduation failure relation.
